name: Family Visa (TR-FV)

requirements.blocker_text: Eligible dependents are spouses, unemancipated children under 18, parents, and step-parents of a Venezuelan citizen; the family must travel together with the citizen sponsor to establish domicile in Venezuela. A marriage held abroad must be registered with a Venezuelan Consular Section or within Venezuela itself. Physical presence at application (not just document submission) is mandatory, along with a criminal record check and health certificate.
requirements.fix_path: Register the marriage/family relationship with a Venezuelan consulate and apply with the required documentation, appearing in person.

sources.title: Embassy of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela in Japan -- official TR-FV Family Visa requirements: eligible dependents, consular registration of marriage, and documentary requirements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Venezuela). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct government sourcing via an official Venezuelan embassy page (tier 1). This route is specifically for family of a VENEZUELAN CITIZEN sponsor -- distinct from ve_work_permit.json's TR-L visa, which separately extends to family members of a foreign TR-L WORKER (not a citizen). work_rights set 'none' since the source describes no independent work authorization for dependents; study_rights set 'restricted' (not asserted 'full' without a source) since the source did not detail dependents' education access. family_can_work left null given the same lack of source coverage.
